title: Concept: Requirement guarded by an interpreter marker
description: requirements.txt declares a requirement whose install depends on an interpreter marker, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a requirement whose install depends on an interpreter marker.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a requirement whose install depends on an interpreter marker.
